description: Wide open battlefield. Arjuna's rampage — no formations, just raw carnage. Day 9 of Bhishma Parva after Krishna nearly breaches his vow.

KAURAVA.note: Scattered Kaurava forces. High unit count.

special_mechanics.arjuna_fury: Arjuna gets +50% attack power this map. Krishna's rage has transferred to him. This is the map where a single Maharathi truly solos dozens.
